name: SBECmd
description: Parse shellbags from registry hives and export the folders a user browsed as CSV or JSON.
about: Shellbags are the view settings Explorer stores for folders a user has opened, which makes them a record of folders that were browsed — including folders on removable media, network shares and archives that are no longer present. SBECmd reads them from the UsrClass.dat and NTUSER.DAT hives in a directory, reconstructing each entry's full path and the timestamps stored alongside it, and writes the result to CSV or JSON. Given a directory of hives it can process them together and drop duplicate entries. It can also read the live registry instead, which requires Administrator rights.
